result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal content clipping and bottom navigation overlap make parts of the interface look cut off.

issues.description: The category carousel and the “Fastest near you” restaurant row extend beyond the right edge of the screen, leaving the next pill and the third restaurant card visibly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel is intentionally scrollable with clear affordance, or constrain card widths and spacing so items do not appear accidentally clipped.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the second restaurant card, obscuring its image and likely its title and metadata.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or stop scrolling before the navigation area so cards remain fully visible above the fixed navigation bar.
